title: Card Flipping Game
description: Find the smallest integer on the face of a card that is not on the back of any card after flipping.
pseudocode:
1. let forbidden = new Set()
2. for i = 0 to fronts.length - 1:
3.   if fronts[i] == backs[i]: forbidden.add(fronts[i])
4. let minVal = Infinity
5. for i = 0 to fronts.length - 1:
6.   if !forbidden.has(fronts[i]): minVal = min(minVal, fronts[i])
7.   if !forbidden.has(backs[i]): minVal = min(minVal, backs[i])
8. return minVal == Infinity ? 0 : minVal

steps.note: Identify cards with same front and back (e.g., [4, 4]).
1 is not forbidden, update minVal to 1.
